operational_preflight_v1.design_response: remove donor-identity entropy as a hard rejection because uniform weight over agreeing donors is redundancy, not uncertainty; replace it prospectively with a label-blind learned retain/transport gate driven by donor validity and feature disagreement

operational_preflight_v2.result: 112 true-track inputs; 126/128 valid affine fits; donor consensus exercised on 32/32 mask rows; projected primary-only 128-center path 225.81 seconds; independently replayed byte-exact
operational_preflight_v2.remaining_correction: the earlier 896-forward cost excluded 496 wrong-track control crops; add all 64 preflight wrong-track crops before authorizing the 128-center screen

operational_preflight_v4.result: 176-input control-inclusive operational preflight passed and independently replayed byte-exact across eight arrays and four substantive receipts; true-track consensus covered 32/32 mask rows and all 3413 targets, while wrong-track consensus covered any target in 30/32 rows and used explicit retain for 306 targets
operational_preflight_v4.interpretation: source, masking, frozen DINO, transport, negative-control and exact-replay mechanics are operationally validated; no reconstruction comparison, learned gate, task fit, router fit, macro-F1 claim or scientific gate was evaluated

ccac_measurement_feasibility.scope: camera and actor-region correspondence feasibility only; not evidence that its failed task reader should be reused

primary_hypothesis: A same-track partial-transport model with an explicit dustbin can reconstruct deliberately hidden center-time actor features at least 10 percent better than an equal-input unaligned neighbor pool on at least eight of eleven scenarios, at least 5 percent better than center-only and same-grid controls overall, and the advantage depends on true neighbor content, correct actor association, and correct spatial structure.

inference_contract.endpoint: offline supplied-box within-recording track; future-frame lookahead is explicit
available_inputs: physical frame offsets and decode validity
ARFTR prediction only in the later retained-system evaluation
inference_contract.missing_or_low_confidence_action: no_transport; later integrated system copies exact ARFTR probabilities
inference_contract.latency: uses up to 7/30 seconds of future lookahead; any streaming claim requires a separately locked past-only control

pilot.population: the existing 128 scenario-balanced, label-blind body-pilot sample IDs in their frozen order
pilot.wrong_track_control_views: four additional fixed-map crops per center when available; 64/64 in preflight and 496/512 in the full pilot paired support
pilot.crop_source: exact image_member bytes from the pinned provider-supplied 1280x720 JPEG archive and same-track boxes; no original-video decode, nearest-frame, alternate-member, or other-track fallback

image_encoder.preprocessing: integer expanded crop with raw RGB [124,116,104] out-of-frame padding; aspect-preserving PIL bilinear letterbox to 384x384; ImageNet normalization; no processor defaults
image_encoder.independent_encoding: each center or neighbor crop is encoded separately; no video-context token may have seen the hidden center pixels

definitions: upper: fill actor-box pixels with normalized y in [0.00,0.525), score only [0.00,0.475), and use fully supported [0.525,1.00] patches as visible anchors
lower: fill actor-box pixels with normalized y in [0.475,1.00], score only [0.525,1.00], and use fully supported [0.00,0.475) patches as visible anchors
center_masks.fill: fixed raw RGB [124,116,104] before resize and normalization
center_masks.spatial_scope: mask only raw pixels whose centers lie inside the supplied actor-box x range and the named actor-relative y band; pixels outside actor x or outside the band remain visible
center_masks.target: detached unmasked-center DINO patch features at target-grid cells
center_masks.target_cell_membership: propagate a binary raw mask through the exact PIL-bilinear letterbox; a target cell is scored only when every one of its 14x14 DINO input pixels has value 255, proving its complete resize/patch receptive footprint lies inside the raw masked region
center_masks.visible_anchor_cell_membership: a center cell is an anchor candidate only when every one of its 14x14 input pixels has full valid-source support and lies outside the filled actor band; boundary, middle-band, and padding-contaminated cells are neither targets nor anchors

partial_transport.name: Visible-Anchor Partial Transport Completion
partial_transport.visible_anchor_matches: L2-normalize float32 tokens with denominator floor 1e-12; mutual maximum-cosine matches between valid non-target center cells and valid neighbor cells inside Chebyshev radius 4 on the 27x27 grid; exact ties choose lowest row-major index
partial_transport.geometry: fit the direction center-grid xy -> neighbor-grid xy from visible anchors, then bilinearly sample neighbor tokens at mapped hidden-center xy; a sample is valid only when its complete four-cell interpolation support is valid
partial_transport.robust_fit: initialize identity linear part plus median matched displacement; run exactly five Euclidean-residual Huber IRLS iterations with delta 1.5 grid cells; require rank 3 and weighted-design condition number <=10000; report sum(weight*Euclidean residual)/sum(weight)
partial_transport.dustbin: one explicit no-transport state per target token
dustbin_triggers: weighted fit residual above 2 grid cells
partial_transport.donor_weights: for donor d and target t, logit is median cosine of the four nearest matched visible anchors minus 0.25 times affine weighted residual minus 0.10 times target-to-nearest-anchor grid distance; softmax temperature is 0.25 over valid donors only; donor-weight entropy is logged as a feature and never used as a hard rejection
partial_transport.consensus: take a componentwise weighted median of up to four valid transported donor vectors (lowest donor offset breaks exact weighted-median ties); all-invalid donors expose no consensus
partial_transport.retain_transport_gate: hard retain when no donor is valid; otherwise g=H*sigmoid(Linear32to1(GELU(Linear21to32(LayerNorm of the fixed 21 inference features)))); output=(1-g)*P0_prediction+g*transport_prediction, so retain/no-transport is explicit at every target
partial_transport.gate_features_21: valid-donor fraction; for each offset [-8,-4,+4,+7]: valid bit, residual/2 clipped to [0,1], local median anchor cosine clipped to [-1,1], nearest-anchor distance/4 clipped to [0,1]; median and maximum pairwise cosine distance among valid transported vectors (zero when fewer than two); past-valid fraction; future-valid fraction

self_supervised_arms.P0_center_only: masked-center visible context and target positions; no neighbors
self_supervised_arms.P1_unordered_pool: P0 plus equal-input global unordered neighbor patch pool
self_supervised_arms.P2_same_grid_pool: P0 plus same normalized-grid neighbor features; no correspondence refinement
self_supervised_arms.P3_partial_transport: explicit learned convex choice between the P0 prediction and a visible-anchor transported-consensus prediction; the 21-feature gate sees no hidden target or action signal

matched_decoder.architecture: LayerNorm then two-layer 256-wide GELU residual MLP per target token
matched_decoder.inputs: arm-specific evidence, target position, mask ID, four physical offsets, observation-valid bits
matched_decoder.loss: center-mean of 1-cosine plus 0.25 times LayerNorm-space Huber, plus 0.01 times mean transport gate g as an intervention cost; center is the primary error unit and unavailable targets contribute zero without denominator deletion
matched_decoder.splits: five existing outer scenario folds; fit on four folds and predict only held scenarios
matched_decoder.training: one seed 42, at most 400 updates per arm/fold, AdamW 3e-4, batch 64 centers, no held-target early stopping
matched_decoder.capacity: P1/P2/P3 active trainable parameter counts within 10 percent; P0 reported as an information ablation

negative_controls.wrong_track: at the identical recording/frame slot, enumerate different supplied tracks with zero pixel-edge box intersection; select the SHA256-minimum canonical tuple under salt center-completion-wrong-track-v1, where tuple is sample_id|time_index|track_id|bbox values formatted to 12 significant digits; score only the fixed paired common support of 124 centers/496 slots and never change the denominator
negative_controls.repeated_masked_center: at evaluation, replace all four donors with copies of the masked-center representation while retaining the fitted P3 checkpoint and identical active paths; no extra fit
negative_controls.spatial_reassignment: fixed hash permutation of transported target positions within each crop
negative_controls.time_reversal: swap past and future offset metadata without changing feature tensors
negative_controls.center_target_leakage: alter every hidden center pixel and require every pre-target input tensor to remain bit-exact

pilot.stop: If any pilot gate fails, do not extract the full bank or fit action labels; retain ARFTR. A short-window failure falsifies only this short-window formulation; a wider-window test may be planned later only when the diagnosed failure is near-duplicate donors rather than failed association or transport.

conditional_action_screen.authorized_only_if: every pilot gate passes and a new versioned execution lock measures projected runtime below the handoff boundary

arms.A0_center: actual unmasked center plus common context
arms.A1_pool: A0 plus equal-input unordered neighbor tokens
arms.A2_align: A0 plus aligned transported tokens and confidence, no completion objective or completed feature
arms.A3_completion: A2 plus completed center target, observed-minus-completed residual, uncertainty, and explicit no-transport representation

common_requirements: identical center and neighbor pixels for A1/A2/A3
all active task-trained parameters below one million
A1/A2/A3 parameter range at most 10 percent using useful paths only
all fitting and model selection strictly within each outer training fold
alignment and completion parameters are fit label-blind and frozen before class-balanced action cross-entropy
all 4977 held predictions released together after independent checkpoint replay
conditional_action_screen.confirmation: Only a passed initial gate authorizes seeds 43 and 44; apply the same gates to probability means and require seed macro-F1 SD <=0.0075.

retained_system_gate.architecture: ARFTR-preserving abstaining expert with retain as an explicit action; a weaker completion expert can never overwrite broadly
retained_system_gate.decision_training: strictly inside each outer training fold with complete ancestor exclusions; held labels never train a router, calibrate confidence, or select a threshold
retained_system_gate.structural_feasibility: No integration run is authorized until the prior nested-ancestor infeasibility is resolved without relaxing exclusions. A representation pass alone is not deployment performance.

compute_boundary.preflight_selection: first frozen pilot-selection row per scenario, followed by SHA256-minimum remaining rows under salt center-completion-preflight-v1 until 16; sort selected rows back into frozen pilot order
compute_boundary.preflight_scope: source hash/member validation, exact crop/mask/dependency replay, DINO shape/finiteness/runtime, synthetic affine transport, true-track and fixed-map wrong-track transport-consensus code-path smoke only; the learned gate is not fit and no reconstruction comparison or pilot gate may be claimed
compute_boundary.if_projection_exceeds_boundary: prepare command and new run directory, verify bounded startup, then stop for user handoff

one immutable 128-center label-blind feature extraction containing teacher, two masked-center, four true-track-neighbor and fixed-map wrong-track-control streams
the preregistered label-blind reconstruction screen after cache replay and dependency audit
